I always saw him at terrace staring at me. For first few days it looked weird to me, I did not know what he wanted from me… I lived there alone. Even though there were many neighbors around but were not communicative. So for few days when I noticed he starred me I got afraid but he said nothing, did nothing and only starred. Gradually I also got interested in him. I observed him every mood, sometimes sad, sometimes happy, sometimes cheerful, and sometimes depressed. I grew fond of him. Now I also used to wait for him. He was very punctual, always coming on time. One day, as always I was waiting for him but he did not reach on time. He was never late so it made me worry about him. I knew nothing about him so that day I talked to a neighbor and inquired about him. I asked everything I wanted to know about him. I even got the answer that why he starred me. The neighbor told me that whenever a human stares a star he wants the star to make his wish come true…. I was thinking about him suddenly he appeared at terrace again staring at me… That day I wanted to speak to him and tell him that it’s not we, the stars, which can make his wish come true but he himself can do it. By stopping wishing for a miracle to happen and helping himself to achieve what he wants….
